queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Thorium' AND publisher = 'EDRLab';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Thorium' AND publisher = 'EDRLab' AND version_compare(version, '3.5.1') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'thorium reader.exe');
